subject: ZeroHour access governance RFI - IAM matrix and evidence
messages:
From: Arielle Stone <arielle.stone@zerohour.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@zerohour.com, Thomas Liu <t.liu@zerohour.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: ZeroHour RFI - IAM section + requested evidence

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for agreeing to help with our vendor RFI. Attached is the IAM worksheet we use for procurement (ZeroHour_RFI_IAM.xlsx). The procurement team has a few targeted questions we flagged for vendors: SAML/OIDC support (multiple IdPs), SCIM outbound provisioning (users + groups), RBAC model and delegated admin capabilities, audit logging granularity (per-token, per-user), and key management for data-at-rest.

Two asks for you:
- Can you confirm which of the above Redwood supports today vs. planned within the next 6 months?
- Can you attach any evidentiary docs (SOC reports, implementation guides, API spec excerpts) or diagrams that explain your SCIM and SSO flows?

We're on a tight timeline; procurement would ideally have completed vendor responses by Oct 18. If a short call (30 min) would help, we're available Friday 10/15 between 10:00-14:00 PT.

Appreciate it — Arielle
Arielle Stone
Technical Sourcing | ZeroHour Security
arielle.stone@zerohour.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Arielle Stone <arielle.stone@zerohour.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ZeroHour RFI - IAM section + requested evidence

Hi Arielle,

Thanks for sending — we received the worksheet. We'll fill the matrix and return a completed package with supporting evidence by EOD Oct 13 to give you a day for review ahead of your Oct 18 cutoff. If that timing doesn't work, let me know.

Short answers up-front:
- SAML and OIDC (multiple IdPs): supported today (SAML 2.0, OIDC RP).
- SCIM: outbound provisioning supported for users and groups (SCIM 2.0) — we have a documented API with token scopes.
- RBAC: role-based model with tenant-level and org-level admin roles; fine-grained perms for model access and billing.
- Audit logs: per-request and per-user audit trails available (retention configurable).
- KMS: customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integrations on Private deployments; hosted offers managed KMS with export controls.

Would you prefer the completed workbook returned as an XLSX and a PDF evidence bundle? We can also share a short SCIM sequence diagram and our SOC2 redacted report.

I can take a 30-min call Friday 10/15 at 11:00 PT — please confirm if that works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Kimberly / team,

Attached is the updated matrix with SCIM section fleshed out (Redwood_IAM_Matrix_v2.xlsx). Key notes:
- SCIM: v2; supports bulk user creation, patch semantics for user attributes, group membership reconciliation.
- SCIM provisioning tokens: scoped tokens per-client with ability to restrict to user-only or user+group provisioning.
- Rate limits and throttling: 500 req/min for provisioning endpoints (we can provide higher limits on Dedicated).
- Example edge-cases: GUID mismatch remediation flow (we include federatedId mapping) and a reconciliation job runbook.

Attachments included: Redwood_IAM_Matrix_v2.xlsx, sso-diagram.png, scim-api-spec.md

Question for procurement: do they want group-based entitlements mapped into RBAC roles or do they prefer group -> SCIM-only synchronization and leave RBAC mapping to the customer? We should flag both options in the matrix.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Subject: Completed: ZeroHour IAM RFI responses and evidence bundle

Arielle / procurement team —

Thanks for the patience. Attached is our completed IAM worksheet and evidence bundle: Redwood_IAM_Matrix_v2.xlsx and a zip of supporting artifacts (aws-soc2-report.pdf [redacted], sso-implementation-guide.pdf, scim-api-spec.md, sso-diagram.png). High-level summary below:

- SSO (SAML + OIDC): Supported today for hosted and Dedicated. Multiple IdP support; SAML 2.0 attributes mapping; OIDC RP. We provided a short SAML attribute mapping table in the workbook.
- SCIM provisioning: SCIM 2.0 outbound provisioning for users and groups; scoped tokens and reconciliation flows documented. Preferred deployment model: Hosted customers use token-based SCIM; Dedicated/Private customers can use mutual-TLS or VPC endpoints for additional isolation.
- RBAC and admin controls: Tenant-level roles, delegated admin, and fine-grained permission model. We spelled out role names and enforcement points in the matrix and included recommended guardrails for admin delegation.
- Audit & logging: Per-request audit trails stored for configurable retention windows (default 90 days for hosted; enterprise retention available). Logs include actor, IP, token id, action, and resource id.
- KMS/keys: Hosted: managed KMS with strict export controls; Private: customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integrations (we list supported providers in the evidence bundle).

Next steps I propose:
1) Review the workbook and tell me any clarifications needed by Tue 10/19.
2) If you want a short walkthrough of SCIM and RBAC with examples, we can set a 30-min session (I recommend Marissa and Rishi join).
